title: billing.subscription.started payload
description: The `data` payload of the `billing.subscription.started` event: a subscription became active. A trial counts as started, which is why `status` distinguishes the two. The envelope is validated by schemas/event-envelope.schema.json; this schema validates what is inside `data`. The file path is the event type with dots as directory separators. See docs/event-naming.md.

subscription_id.description: The subscription. Always equal to the envelope's `subject`.

plan_id.description: The plan this subscription is on, as of the moment it started. Later plan changes are `billing.subscription.updated`.

account_id.description: The account being billed. The same value as the identity-side account, so cross-service correlation needs no lookup table.

status.description: `trialing` when the subscription started in a trial and has not charged yet, `active` when it has. There is no `past_due` here: a failed first charge is `billing.payment.failed` followed by `billing.subscription.past_due`.

quantity.description: Number of units the subscription bills for. Seats on a per-seat plan, units on a metered one.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, uppercase. Every amount in cafaye is an integer in this currency's minor units — never a float, never a bare number.

trial_ends_at.description: RFC3339 UTC when a trial ends, or null when there is no trial. Present only while `status` is `trialing`.

started_at.description: RFC3339 UTC when the subscription became active. Always equal to the envelope's `time`, so a consumer can render a timeline without trusting the transport.
